title: kith-attach: write_blob has no max_bytes — size guard is caller-only
description: kith-attach/src/lib.rs — write_blob(id, data: &[u8]) accepts an unbounded slice; streaming twin write_blob_streaming requires max_bytes as mandatory. Current callers pre-limit data via Limited before calling, so no exploit today. But the API asymmetry is a footgun: a future caller passing peer-derived bytes to write_blob silently bypasses all size limits. Fix: add max_bytes: usize parameter to write_blob and return Err if data.len() > max_bytes, consistent with streaming API.
